scope: Complete bundled APIs/UI and independently authored 6502 fixtures; banked write provenance, trace filtering/machine-state parity, bounds, lifecycle and export isolation. Not full library recovery, engine identification, audible playback, browser layout or hardware acceptance.

results.name: Audio report starts empty and invalid modes cannot alter observations
Default mode retains PPU, APU, watches and physical source evidence
Audio-focused mode excludes PPU evidence while exact machine state and watches are preserved
A PPU-heavy interval cannot exhaust the audio event budget or stop graphics writes
Writer grouping separates the same CPU address in different physical MMC3 banks
RAM writer sites and writes with no CPU origin remain explicitly unmapped
Noise/DMC observations count register requests without inventing samples or audible notes
Derived reports cannot mutate the retained evidence, source ROM or active project
Audio-focused mode retains the event cap and stops recording while emulation continues
Reset, clear and replacement discard audio evidence and restore default mode
Audio UI selects the explicit mode, lists writers and opens verified originating code
Audio source jumps refuse a different inspected ROM and a reset session
Audio export preserves exact identity/evidence through cancellation and refuses stale UI sessions
Audio UI paginates writer sites without omission or duplication
